# Quality Control / Repository-only travel time and delta travel time grids
# for all 15 flood scenarios. Not for manuscript supplement.

## Setup
```{r}
source(here::here("Code/utils/loading_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/impact_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/00_scenario_definitions.R"))

load_processed_data()
```

## 1. Travel Time Grids (All 15 scenarios)
```{r}
tt_colors_supp <- viridisLite::turbo(8)
tt_breaks <- c(0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180) 
tt_labels <- c("0-15", "15-30", "30-45", "45-60", "60-90", "90-120", "120-180", ">180")

flood_tt_all_stack <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "all")
names(flood_tt_all_stack) <- scenarios_all$label_plot

figS9_tt_grid <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = flood_tt_all_stack) +
  facet_wrap(~lyr, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    name = "Travel Time (min)",
    colours = tt_colors_supp,
    breaks = tt_breaks,
    labels = tt_labels,
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

save_manuscript_pdf(figS9_tt_grid, "travel_time_15scenarios_grid", subdir = "QC", width = 20, height = 30)
```

## 2. Delta Travel Time Grids (All 15 scenarios)
```{r}
delta_colors_supp <- colorRampPalette(viridisLite::turbo(9))(9)
delta_breaks <- c(0, 0.01, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180)
delta_labels <- c("0", "0.01-15", "15-30", "30-45", "45-60", "60-90", "90-120", "120-180", ">180")

x_delta_all_supp <- calculate_delta_stack(flood_tt_all_stack, base_tt_all)
names(x_delta_all_supp) <- scenarios_all$label_plot

figS10_delta_all_grid <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = x_delta_all_supp) +
  facet_wrap(~lyr, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    name = "Δ Travel Time (min)",
    colours = delta_colors_supp,
    breaks = delta_breaks,
    labels = delta_labels,
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

save_manuscript_pdf(figS10_delta_all_grid, "delta_tt_15scenarios_all_facilities_grid", subdir = "QC", width = 20, height = 30)

save_delta_rasters(x_delta_all_supp, "processed/delta_travel_all")
```
